_comment: Least-privilege MongoDB roles for UCTSM (P14-04). <db> is the UCTSM database of ONE environment; never reuse a role or password across environments. Apply with deploy/mongo/create_roles.mongosh.js.

uctsm_runtime.purpose: The API and workers. Reads and writes documents only; cannot change schema, indexes or drop anything.

uctsm_migrator.purpose: Run versioned migrations at deploy time only; not used by the running service.

uctsm_backup_reader.purpose: Encrypted logical snapshots and drills read the database; it cannot write.

network.bind: private address only; never 0.0.0.0 on a public interface
network.tls: required (tls=true or mongodb+srv); certificate validation must stay on
network.authentication: required; SCRAM or X.509; one credential set per environment and per role
network.secrets: connection strings come from the secret store / environment, never from the repository
